name: King's Indian Attack
description: A setup-based opening course that teaches consistent development patterns and kingside safety.

branches.title: Main Line: Safe Setup
branches.description: Build the Nf3-g3-Bg2 setup against a normal Black response.

moves.title: Develop first
moves.explanation: Nf3 develops, controls central squares, and keeps the setup flexible.

moves.title: Prepare the bishop
moves.explanation: g3 opens a safe home for the bishop and supports castling.

moves.title: Black develops
moves.explanation: Black improves a knight and controls e4.

moves.title: Fianchetto
moves.explanation: Bg2 puts the bishop on the long diagonal and prepares king safety.

hints: The key training move in this branch is Bg2.
Follow the highlighted move and keep your plan simple.
coachingNotes: Build the Nf3-g3-Bg2 setup against a normal Black response.

branches.title: Keep the Setup
branches.description: If Black challenges the center with c5, continue calmly.

moves.title: Black challenges
moves.explanation: Black grabs space from the side.

moves.title: Recommended: prepare Bg2
moves.explanation: Keep the setup. The bishop will help control central dark squares.

hints: The key training move in this branch is g3.
Follow the highlighted move and keep your plan simple.
coachingNotes: If Black challenges the center with c5, continue calmly.

branches.title: Fianchetto Anyway
branches.description: If Black prepares d5, build your reliable setup.

moves.title: Black prepares
moves.explanation: Black supports d5 and opens the bishop.

moves.title: Recommended: prepare Bg2
moves.explanation: g3 keeps White's king safe and builds the standard structure.

hints: The key training move in this branch is g3.
Follow the highlighted move and keep your plan simple.
coachingNotes: If Black prepares d5, build your reliable setup.
g3 keeps White's king safe and builds the standard structure.

branches.title: Break the Pin Calmly
branches.description: If Black pins the knight, develop and prepare to ask the bishop a question later.

moves.title: Black pins
moves.explanation: Black pins the knight to the queen.

moves.title: Recommended: develop
moves.explanation: Finish the fianchetto. You can deal with the pin later after castling.

Follow the highlighted move and keep your plan simple.

hints: The key training move in this branch is Bg2.

ideas: Build a reliable setup regardless of Black's moves.
Fianchetto the bishop for king safety.
commonMistakes: Forgetting the bishop belongs on g2.
